εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14]], [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[john 15 18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[luke 16 31|Luk.16:31]], [[romans 8 11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[john 5 47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (b) fut.: [[matthew 26 33|Mat.26:33]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (with) pf.: [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], al.; (d) aor.: [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[john 13 32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[revelation 20 15|Rev.20:15]], al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]], [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-john 3 13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[numbers 14 3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1-samuel 14 45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12.]] 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[luke 13 23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], al. III. With other particles. 1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18;]] but even if, [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7]], [[2-corinthians 4 3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[john 14 2|Jhn.14:2]], [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5]], al. 4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: [[mark 14 29|Mrk.14:29]], [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8]], [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21]], [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17]], al. 5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22]], [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[john 9 33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]] (only), [[galatians 1 19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1-corinthians 14 5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19]]. 7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[ezekiel 33 27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[hebrews 6 14|Heb.6:14]]. 8. εἴ πως, if haply: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]]. 9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1-corinthians 3 22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al. (AS)

εἴ-περ, see: εἰ. εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14]], [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[john 15 18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[luke 16 31|Luk.16:31]], [[romans 8 11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[john 5 47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (b) fut.: [[matthew 26 33|Mat.26:33]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (with) pf.: [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], al.; (d) aor.: [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[john 13 32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[revelation 20 15|Rev.20:15]], al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]], [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-john 3 13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[numbers 14 3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1-samuel 14 45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12.]] 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[luke 13 23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], al. III. With other particles. 1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18;]] but even if, [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7]], [[2-corinthians 4 3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[john 14 2|Jhn.14:2]], [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5]], al. 4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: [[mark 14 29|Mrk.14:29]], [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8]], [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21]], [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17]], al. 5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22]], [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[john 9 33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]] (only), [[galatians 1 19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1-corinthians 14 5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19]]. 7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[ezekiel 33 27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[hebrews 6 14|Heb.6:14]]. 8. εἴ πως, if haply: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]]. 9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1-corinthians 3 22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al. (AS)

εἴ-πως, see: εἰ. εἰ, conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions. I. Conditional, if; 1. with indic, expressing a general assumption; (a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14]], [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[mark 4 23|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[john 15 18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1-corinthians 7 9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[luke 16 31|Luk.16:31]], [[romans 8 11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[matthew 12 26|Mat.12:26]], [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[luke 17 6|Luk.17:6]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[john 5 47|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (b) fut.: [[matthew 26 33|Mat.26:33]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]]; (with) pf.: [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[romans 6 5|Rom.6:5]], al.; (d) aor.: [[luke 16 11|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[john 13 32|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[revelation 20 15|Rev.20:15]], al. 2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: [[matthew 12 28|Mat.12:28]], [[john 7 4|Jhn.7:4]], [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], al. 3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i). 4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-john 3 13|1Jn.3:13]], al. 5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[numbers 14 3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1-samuel 14 45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[mark 8 12|Mrk.8:12]], [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX). 6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: [[acts 24 19|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17. II. Interrogative, if, whether. 1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[matthew 26 63|Mat.26:63]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[mark 3 2|Mrk.3:2]], [[acts 8 22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1-corinthians 1 16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12.]] 2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[luke 13 23|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2]], al. With other particles. 1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε. 2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: [[luke 11 18|Luk.11:18;]] but even if, [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7]], [[2-corinthians 4 3|2Co.4:3 11:16]]. 3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[john 14 2|Jhn.14:2]], [[revelation 2 5|Rev.2:5]], al. 4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: [[mark 14 29|Mrk.14:29]], [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8]], [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21]], [[2-corinthians 4 16|2Co.4:16]], [[philippians 2 17|Php.2:17]], al. 5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί 6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22]], [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[john 9 33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]] (only), [[galatians 1 19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1-corinthians 14 5|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19]]. 7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely ([[ezekiel 33 27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[hebrews 6 14|Heb.6:14]]. 8. εἴ πως, if haply: [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]]. 9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; [[romans 12 6|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1-corinthians 3 22|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al. (AS)

εἰρηνεύω (εἰρήνη), [in LXX chiefly for שׁלם, שׁקט ;] 1. to bring to peace, reconcile (so 1Ma.6:60). 2. to keep peace, be at peace: [[mark 9 50|Mrk.9:50]], [[romans 12 18|Rom.12:18]], [[2-corinthians 13 11|2Co.13:11]], [[1-thessalonians 5 13|1Th.5:13]] (cf. Sir.28:9; Cremer, 246). † (AS)

εἰρήνη, -ης, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם ;] peace; 1. of public peace, freedom from war: [[luke 14 32|Luk.14:32]], [[acts 12 20|Act.12:20 24:2]]; of the church, [[acts 9 31|Ac 9:31]]. 2. Of peace between persons, concord, agreement : [[matthew 10 34|Mat.10:34]], [[luke 12 51|Luk.12:51]], [[romans 14 17|Rom.14:17]], [[1-corinthians 7 15|1Co.7:15]], [[galatians 5 22|Gal.5:22]], [[james 3 18|Jas.3:18;]] ζητεῖν εἰ., [[1-peter 3 11|1Pe.3:11;]] διώκειν, [[2-timothy 2 22|2Ti.2:22;]] ib. before μετὰ πάντων, [[hebrews 12 14|Heb.12:14;]] by meton., of him who brings peace, [[ephesians 2 14|Eph.2:14.]] 3. [[1-samuel 1 17|1Ki.1:17]], al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), [[john 20 19|Jhn.20:19, 21, 26]]; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., [[luke 2 29|Luk.2:29]], cf. [[1-corinthians 16 11|1Co.16:11;]] ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, [[matthew 10 13|Mat.10:13]], [[luke 10 6|Luk.10:6]]; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib. 4. (see Cremer, 244). (AS)
είρηνικός, -ή, -όν (εἰρήνη), [in LXX for שָׁלוֹם and cognates ;] peaceful: [[hebrews 12 11|Heb.12:11]], [[james 3 17|Jas.3:17]].† (AS)

εἰς, prep. with accusative, expressing entrance, direction, limit, into, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among (Lat. in, with accusative). I. Of place. 1. After verbs of motion; (a) of entrance into: [[matthew 8 23|Mat.8:23, 9:7]], [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], [[luke 2 15|Luk.2:15, 8:31]], al.; (b) of approach, to or towards: [[mark 11 1|Mrk.11:1]], [[luke 6 8|Luk.6:8, 19:28]], [[john 11 31|Jhn.11:31, 21:6]], al.; (with) before pl. and collective nouns, among: [[mark 4 7|Mrk.4:7, 8:19, 20]], [[luke 11 49|Luk.11:49]], [[john 21 23|Jhn.21:23]], al.; (d) Of a limit reached, unto, on, upon: [[matthew 8 18|Mat.8:18, 21:1]], [[mark 11 1|Mrk.11:1, 13:16]], [[luke 14 10|Luk.14:10]], [[john 6 3|Jhn.6:3, 11:32]], al.; with accusative of person(s) (as in Ep. and Ion.), [[acts 23 15|Act.23:15]], [[romans 5 12|Rom.5:12, 16:19]], [[2-corinthians 10 14|2Co.10:14]]; (e) elliptical: ἐπιστολαὶ εἰς Δαμασκόν, [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2;]] ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἱ., [[romans 15 31|Rom.15:31;]] metaphorically, of entrance into a certain state or condition, or of approach or direction towards some end (Thayer, B, i, 1; ii, 1), εἰς τ. ὄνομα, M, Pr., 200. 2. Of direction; (a) after verbs of seeing: [[matthew 6 26|Mat.6:26]], [[mark 6 41|Mrk.6:41]], [[luke 9 16|Luk.9:16, 62]], [[john 13 22|Jhn.13:22]], al.; metaphorically, of the mind, [[hebrews 11 26|Heb.11:26, 12:2]], al.; (b) after verbs of speaking: [[matthew 13 10|Mat.13:10, 14:9]], [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]], al. 3. After verbs of rest; (a) in "pregnant" construction, implying previous motion (cl.; see WM, 516; Bl., §39, 3; M, Pr., 234f.): [[matthew 2 23|Mat.2:23, 4:13]], [[2-thessalonians 2 4|2Th.2:4]], [[2-timothy 1 11|2Ti.1:11]], [[hebrews 11 9|Heb.11:9]], al.; (b) by an assimilation general in late Gk (see Bl., M, Pr., ll. with) = ἐν: [[luke 1 44|Luk.1:44, 4:23]], [[acts 20 16|Act.20:16, 21:17]], [[john 1 18|Jhn.1:18]] (but see Westc, in l.), al. II. Of time, for, unto; 1. accentuating the duration expressed by the accusative: εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19;]] εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γ., [[luke 1 50|Luk.1:50;]] εἰς τ. διηνεκές, [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3]], al. 2. Of a point or limit of time, unto, up to, until: [[matthew 6 34|Mat.6:34]], [[acts 4 3|Act.4:3, 25:21]], [[philippians 1 10|Php.1:10, 2:16]], [[1-thessalonians 4 15|1Th.4:15]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12]]; of entrance into a future period, σεις τὸ μέλλον (see: μέλλω), next (year), [[luke 13 9|Luk.13:9]] (but with ICC, in l.); εἰς τ. μεταξὺ σάββατον, on the next Sabbath, [[acts 13 42|Act.13:42;]] εἰς τὸ πάλιν (see: πάλιν, [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2.]] III. Of result, after verbs of changing, joining, dividing, etc.: στρέφειν εἰς, [[revelation 11 6|Rev.11:6;]] μετας-, [[acts 2 20|Act.2:20]], [[james 4 9|Jas.4:9]]; μεταλλάσσειν, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26;]] σχίζειν εἰς δύο, [[matthew 27 51|Mat.27:51]], al.; predicatively with εἴναι, [[acts 8 23|Act.8:23.]] IV. Of relation, to, towards, for, in regard to (so in cl., but more frequently in late Gk., εἰς encroaching on the simple dative, which it has wholly displaced in MGr.; Jannaris, Gr., §1541; Robertson, Gr., 594; Deiss., BS, 117f.): [[luke 7 30|Luk.7:30]], [[romans 4 20|Rom.4:20, 15:2, 26]], [[1-corinthians 16 1|1Co.16:1]], [[ephesians 3 16|Eph.3:16]], al.; ἀγάπη εἰς, [[romans 5 8|Rom.5:8]], al.; χρηστός, [[ephesians 4 32|Eph.4:32;]] φρονεῖν εἰς, [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16;]] θαρρεῖν, [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1.]] V. Of the end or object: εὔθετος εἰς, [[luke 14 34|Luk.14:34;]] σόφος, [[romans 16 19|Rom.16:19;]] ἰσχύειν, [[matthew 5 13|Mat.5:13;]] εἰς τοῦτο, [[mark 1 38|Mrk.1:38]], al.; ἀφορίζειν εἰς, [[romans 1 1|Rom.1:1;]] indicating purpose, εἰς φόβον, [[romans 8 15|Rom.8:15;]] εἰς ἔνδειξιν, [[romans 3 25|Rom.3:25;]] εἰς τό, with inf. (= ἵνα or ὥστε; Bl., §71, 5; M, Pr., 218ff.): [[matthew 20 19|Mat.20:19]], [[romans 1 11|Rom.1:11]], [[1-corinthians 9 18|1Co.9:18]], al. VI. Adverbial phrases: εἰς τέλος, εἰς τὸ πάλιν, etc (see: τέλος, πάλιν, etc.). (AS)

εἷς ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός, cardinal numeral, one; 1. one, as opposite to many: [[matthew 25 15|Mat.25:15]], [[romans 5 12|Rom.5:12]], [[1-corinthians 10 8|1Co.10:8]], al.; as subst., [[romans 5 15|Rom.5:15]], [[ephesians 2 14|Eph.2:14]]; id. with genitive partit., [[matthew 5 19|Mat.5:19]], al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), [[mark 14 18|Mrk.14:18]], [[john 6 8|Jhn.6:8]], al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, [[john 10 30|Jhn.10:30 17:11]], [[romans 12 4|Rom.12:4-5]], [[philippians 1 27|Php.1:27]]; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), [[luke 14 18|Luk.14:18;]] with neg., εἷς. . . οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), [[matthew 5 18|Mat.5:18 10:29]], [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46 12:6]]. 2. Emphatically, to the exclusion of others; (a) a single (one): [[matthew 21 24|Mat.21:24]], [[mark 8 14|Mrk.8:14]]; absol., [[1-corinthians 9 24|1Co.9:24]], al.; οὐδὲ εἷς, [[matthew 27 14|Mat.27:14]], [[john 1 3|Jhn.1:3]], [[romans 3 10|Rom.3:10]], al.; (b) one, alone: [[mark 2 7|Mrk.2:7 10:18]], [[luke 18 19|Luk.18:19]]; (with) one and the same: [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30]], [[1-corinthians 3 8|1Co.3:8 11:5 12:11]], [[1-john 5 8|1Jn.5:8]]. 3. In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, [[genesis 22 13|Gen.22:13]], al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): [[matthew 8 19|Mat.8:19 19:6]], [[revelation 8 13|Rev.8:13]], al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), [[luke 22 50|Luk.22:50]], [[john 11 49|Jhn.11:49]] 4. Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), [[luke 4 40|Luk.4:40]], [[acts 2 6|Act.2:6]], al.; εἷς . . . καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν . . . εἷς δέ), [[matthew 17 4|Mat.17:4]], [[mark 9 5|Mrk.9:5]], [[john 20 12|Jhn.20:12]], al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, [[exodus 17 12|Exo.17:12]], al); ὁ εἷς . . . ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος) . . . ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24]], [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41]], [[revelation 17 10|Rev.17:10]]; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: [[mark 14 19|Mrk.14:19]], [[romans 12 5|Rom.12:5]], al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), [[1-thessalonians 5 11|1Th.5:11.]] 5. As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: [[matthew 28 1|Mat.28:1]], [[mark 16 2|Mrk.16:2]], al (AS)

εἰσ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא, hi. ;] to bring in: with accusative, [[luke 2 27|Luk.2:27]], [[john 18 16|Jhn.18:16]], [[acts 7 45|Act.7:45]]; before εἰς, [[luke 22 54|Luk.22:54]], [[acts 9 8|Act.9:8 21:28-29, 37 22:24]], [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]]; ὧδε, [[luke 14 21|Luk.14:21.]]† (AS)

[[deuteronomy 1 43|Deu.1:43]], Sir.3:6) (b) to listen, assent to; pass., to be heard: of persons praying, [[matthew 6 7|Mat.6:7]], [[hebrews 5 7|Heb.5:7]]; of the prayer offered, [[luke 1 13|Luk.1:13]], [[acts 10 31|Act.10:31]] (cf. By attraction = ἐν (cl.): τὰ ἐκ τ. οἰκιας, [[matthew 24 17|Mat.24:17;]] τ. ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν, [[mark 5 30|Mrk.5:30]] (see Field, in l.); ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, [[luke 11 13|Luk.11:13.]] V. Adverbial phrases: ἐξ ἀνάγκης, [[2-corinthians 9 7|2Co.9:7]], [[hebrews 7 12|Heb.7:12]]; ἐξ ἰσότητος, [[2-corinthians 8 13|2Co.8:13;]] ἐκ μέρους, [[1-corinthians 12 27|1Co.12:27 13:9-12]]; ἐκ μέτρου, [[john 3 34|Jhn.3:34;]] ἐκ συμφώνου, [[1-corinthians 7 5|1Co.7:5.]] VI. in composition, ἐκ signifies, 1. procession, removal: ἐκβαίνω, ἐκβάλλω. 2. Opening out, unfolding: ἐκτείνω; metaphorically, ἐξαγγάλλω. 3. Origin: ἔκγονος. 4. Completeness: ἐξαπορέω (see M, Pr., 237), ἐκπληρόω, ἐκτελέω. (AS)

1. every, every one, each, each one , Lat. quisque, (Homer), etc.; the singular is often joined with a pl. Verb, ἔβαν οἴκονδε ἕκαστος they went home every one of them , (Iliad by Homer); ἕκαστος ἐπίστασθε (Xenophon Historicus):—;the singular is also put in apposition with a pl. Noun, Τρῶας ἕκαστον ὑπήλυθε τρόμος (for Τρώων ἕκαστον)) fear seized them every one , (Iliad by Homer) 2. in plural all and each one , (Homer) 3. more definitely, εἷς ἕκαστος, Lat. unusquisque, every single one, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—; καθ᾽ ἕκαστον singly, by itself , Lat. singulatim, (Plato Philosophus), etc. 4. ὡς ἕκαστοι each by himself , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)
ἑκάστοτε adv., each time, always: [[2-peter 1 15|2Pe.1:15.]]† (AS)
ἑκατόν, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., a hundred: [[matthew 13 8|Mat.13:8, 23]] [[luke 15 4|Luk.15:4]], al.; κατὰ ἑ, [[mark 6 40|Mrk.6:40;]] εἰς, ἐν ἑ., [[mark 4 8|Mrk.4:8, 20]] (AS)
ἑκατονταετής (Rec. έτης), -ές (ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, [[genesis 17 17|Gen.17:17]] * ;] a hundred years old: [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19.]]† (AS)
a hundred times as much or many , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

ἐκ-βάλλω [in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;] 1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, [[acts 27 38|Act.27:38;]] pass., [[matthew 15 17|Mat.15:17;]] with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 21 12|Mat.21:12]], [[mark 11 15|Mrk.11:15]], al.; δαιμόνια, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[mark 1 34|Mrk.1:34]], al.; id. before ἐκ, [[mark 7 26|Mrk.7:26;]] παρά, [[mark 16 9|Mrk.16:9;]] ἐν, [[mark 3 22|Mrk.3:22;]] (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[mark 9 38|Mrk.9:38]]; λόγῳ, [[matthew 8 16|Mat.8:16;]] before ἔξω, [[john 6 37|Jhn.6:37;]] id. with genitive, [[mark 12 8|Mrk.12:8]], al.; of expulsion from home, [[galatians 4 30|Gal.4:30;]] from the Church, III Jn 10. 2. In LXX and NT (like Heb. יָצָא and Aram. הַנְפֵּק), to command or cause to depart: [[matthew 9 38|Mat.9:38]], [[mark 1 12|Mrk.1:12]] (see Swete, in l.), ib. [[mark 1 43|Mrk.1:43 5:40]], [[luke 10 2|Luk.10:2]], [[james 2 25|Jas.2:25]]; τ. κρίσιν εἰς νῖκος (to cause to proceed to its goal), [[matthew 12 20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX). 3. to reject (cl.): τ. ὄνομα ὑμῶς ὡς πονηρόν (cf. [[deuteronomy 25 14|Deu.25:14]]), [[luke 6 22|Luk.6:22]]; to leave out, [[revelation 11 2|Rev.11:2.]] 4. to take, draw or pluck out; (a) with violence: [[matthew 7 5|Mat.7:5]], [[mark 9 47|Mrk.9:47]], [[luke 6 42|Luk.6:42]]; (b) to bring forth or out of: [[matthew 12 35|Mat.12:35]], [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35]]. (AS)
ἔκ-βασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐκβαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.2:17 8:8 11:14 * ;] 1. a way out (Hom., Xen.): [[1-corinthians 10 13|1Co.10:13.]] 2. the issue (Menand.) [[hebrews 13 7|Heb.13:7.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-βολή, -ῆς (ἐκβάλλω), [in LXX: [[exodus 11 1|Exo.11:1]] (גָּרַשׁ), [[joshua 1 5|Jos.1:5]] (ἐκβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι, טול hi.), [[ezekiel 47 8|Eze.47:8]] (יָצָא)* ;] 1. a throwing out. 2. a jettison, a throwing overboard of cargo: [[acts 27 18|Act.27:18]] (cf. ἐκ-γαμίζω Rec. for γαμίζω, which see: [[matthew 22 30|Mat.22:30 24:38]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27]], [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38]]. Not elsewhere.† (AS)

ἐκ-γαμίσκω Rec. for γαμίσκω, which see: [[luke 20 34|Luk.20:34-35.]] Not elsewhere.† γαμίζω (γάμος), to give in marriage, a daughter: [[1-corinthians 7 38|1Co.7:38.]] Pass., [[matthew 22 30|Mat.22:30 24:38]], [[mark 12 25|Mrk.12:25]], [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27 20:35]] (WH, mg., γαμίσκονται; cf. γαμίζω).† (AS)

ἔκ-γονος, -ον (ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;] 1. with genitive, born of. 2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, [[1-timothy 5 4|1Ti.5:4.]]† (AS)
εκ-δαπανάω, -ῶ strengthened form of δαπανάω, to spend wholly; pass., with reflexive force, to spend oneself wholly: before ὑπέρ, [[2-corinthians 12 15|2Co.12:15.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-δέχομαι [in LXX for עֶרֶב, קָבַץ, etc. ;] 1. to take or receive from (Hom., Hdt., a1.). 2. (Rare in cl.), to expect, await: with accusative of thing(s), [[john 5 3|Jhn.5:3]], [[hebrews 11 10|Heb.11:10]], [[james 5 7|Jas.5:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[acts 17 16|Act.17:16]], [[1-corinthians 11 33|1Co.11:33 16:11]]; before ἕως, [[hebrews 10 13|Heb.10:13]] (Cremer, 687).† (AS)
ἔκ-δηλος, -ον (δῆλος), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:19 3Mac 6:5 * ;] strengthened form of δῆλος, which see, quite clear, evident: [[2-timothy 3 9|2Ti.3:9.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-δημέω, -ῶ (ἔκδημος, from home; cf. -ία, 3Ma.4:11)*; to be from home, absent: [[2-corinthians 5 6|2Co.5:6;]] before ἀπό, [[2-corinthians 5 8|2Co.5:8;]] before ἐκ, [[2-corinthians 5 9|2Co.5:9]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).† (AS)

ἐκ-δίδωμι [in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;] 1. to surrender, give up, give out. 2. to let out for hire (Hdt.); mid. (as frequently in π.; see MM, Exp., xii); to let out to one's advantage, [[matthew 21 33|Mat.21:33, 41]], [[mark 12 1|Mrk.12:1]], [[luke 20 9|Luk.20:9]].† (AS)
ἐκ-δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι depon., [in LXX chiefly for סָפַר, pi. ;] to tell in detail, relate, declare: [[acts 13 41|Act.13:41]] (LXX) [[acts 15 3|Act.15:3.]]† (AS)

ἐκδικέω, -ῶ (ἔκδικος), [in LXX for פָּקַד, נָקַם, שָׁפַט, etc. ;] 1. to vindicate: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 18 3|Luk.18:3]], 5. 2. to avenge: with accusative of person(s), ἑαυτούς, [[romans 12 19|Rom.12:19;]] with accusative of thing(s), παρακοήν, [[2-corinthians 10 6|2Co.10:6;]] αἷμα, [[revelation 6 10|Rev.6:10 19:2]] (Cremer, 203; for exx. from π. in both senses, see MM, Exp., xii).† (AS)

ἐκ-δίκησις, -εως, ἡ (ἐκδικέω), [in LXX chiefly for נָקָם ;] vengeance, vindication: [[luke 21 22|Luk.21:22]], [[romans 12 19|Rom.12:19]] (see MM, Exp., xii), [[hebrews 10 30|Heb.10:30]] (LXX), [[2-corinthians 7 11|2Co.7:11;]] of the injured person, with genitive, [[luke 18 7|Luk.18:7-8;]] with dative, [[acts 7 24|Act.7:24;]] of the offender, with genitive obj., [[1-peter 2 14|1Pe.2:14;]] with dative, [[2-thessalonians 1 8|2Th.1:8]] (cf. Sir.12:6).† (AS)

ἔκδικος, -ον (δίκη), [in LXX: Wis.12:12, Sir.30:6, 4Ma.15:29 * ;] 1. without law, unjust. 2. exacting penalty from; as subst., an avenger: [[romans 13 4|Rom.13:4;]] before περί, [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]] (in π., a legal representative; Milligan, Th., l.with).† (AS)
ἐκ-διώκω [in LXX for בָּרַח hi., צָמַת, הָדַף, etc. ;] to chase away, drive out: [[1-thessalonians 2 15|1Th.2:15]] (cf. [[deuteronomy 6 19|Deu.6:19]], [[joel 2 20|Jol.2:20]]).† (AS)
ἔκ-δοτος, -ον (ἐκδίδωμι), [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:22 * ;] given up, delivered over: [[acts 2 23|Act.2:23]] (for construction, see Field, Notes, 111 f.).† (AS)

ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ (ἐκδέχομαι); 1. in cl., (a) a receiving from, succession; (b) an interpretation. 2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: [[hebrews 10 27|Heb.10:27]] (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).† (AS)

ἐκ-δύω [in LXX chiefly for פָּשַׁט ;] to take of, strip of, strip: with accusative of person(s) (sc. clothing), [[matthew 27 28|Mat.27:28;]] with accusative of person(s) and of thing(s), [[matthew 27 31|Mat.27:31]], [[mark 15 20|Mrk.15:20]], [[luke 10 30|Luk.10:30]]; mid., to put off: figuratively, of the body, [[2-corinthians 5 4|2Co.5:4.]]† (AS)

(Hdt., Thuc., al.), with verbs of motion, for ἐκεῖσε, thither: [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22 17:20 24:28 26:36]], [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33]], [[luke 12 18|Luk.12:18 17:37 21:2]], [[john 11 8|Jhn.11:8 18:2-3]], [[romans 15 24|Rom.15:24]] (AS)
ἐκεῖθεν adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;] 1. of place, thence: [[matthew 4 21|Mat.4:21]], [[mark 6 1|Mrk.6:1]], al. 2. Of time, thereafter (see: κἀκεῖθεν). (AS)

ἐκεῖνος, -η, -ο (ἐκεῖ), [in LXX chiefly for הַהוּא ,הוּא, and cogn. forms ;] demonstr. pron., that person or thing (ille), implying remoteness as compared with οὗτος (hic); 1. absol., emphatic he, she, it: opposite to οὗτος, [[luke 18 14|Luk.18:14]], [[james 4 15|Jas.4:15]]; ἡμεῖς, [[hebrews 12 25|Heb.12:25;]] ὑμεῖς, [[mark 4 11|Mrk.4:11;]] ἄλλοι, [[john 9 9|Jhn.9:9;]] ἐγώ, [[john 3 30|Jhn.3:30;]] to persons named, Mk 16:[10, 13, 20], [[john 2 21|Jhn.2:21]]; of one (absent) who is not named, contemptuously (Abbott, JG, §§2385, 2732), [[john 7 11|Jhn.7:11 9:28]]; with respect, of Christ, 1Jo.2:6 3:3, al.; referring to a preceding noun, Mrk.16:[10], [[john 7 45|Jhn.7:45]]; resumption of a participial subject, [[john 1 33|Jhn.1:33 9:37 10:1]], [[romans 14 14|Rom.14:14]], al. (on its reference in [[john 19 35|Jhn.19:35]], see Westc, in l.; Moffatt, Intr., 568; Sanday, Fourth Gospel, 77ff.). 2. As adj., joined, like οὗτος, to a noun with the article: [[matthew 7 25|Mat.7:25]], [[mark 3 24|Mrk.3:24]], [[john 18 15|Jhn.18:15]], al.; esp. of time, past or future: ἐν τ. ἡμέραις ἐ., [[matthew 3 1|Mat.3:1]], [[mark 1 9|Mrk.1:9]], [[acts 2 18|Act.2:18]]" (LXX), al.; ἐν ἐ. τ. ἡμέρᾳ, esp of the Parousia, [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[luke 6 23|Luk.6:23]], [[2-thessalonians 1 10|2Th.1:10]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12]]; adverbially, ἐκεινής (sc. ὁδοῦ) = cl. ἐκεινῇ (Bl., §36, 13), that way, [[luke 19 4|Luk.19:4.]] (AS)

ἔκ-θετος, -ον (ἐκτίθημι), [in Al.: [[ezekiel 42 3|Eze.42:3]] * ;] cast out: ποιεῖν ἔ. = ἐκτιθέναι, [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-καίω [in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;] 1. to burn up. 2. to kindle. Pass., to burn: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. Sir.16:6, [[job 3 17|Job.3:17]]), [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]].† (AS)

WH, Notes, 157 f.; κακός, cowardly), [in Sm.: [[genesis 27 46|Gen.27:46]], [[numbers 21 5|Num.21:5]], [[proverbs 3 11|Pro.3:11]], [[isaiah 7 16|Isa.7:16]] *;] to lose heart : [[luke 18 1|Luk.18:1]], [[2-corinthians 4 1|2Co.4:1,16]], [[galatians 6 9|Gal.6:9]], [[ephesians 3 13|Eph.3:13]], [[2-thessalonians 3 13|2Th.3:13]] (Cremer, 330).† (AS)

ἐκ-κλείω [in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., [[exodus 23 2|Exo.23:2]] (also as seel., [[job 34 20|Job.34:20]], [[psalms 67 1|Psa.67:1-7]] ([[psalms 68 30|Psa.68:30]]) * ;] to shut out: [[galatians 4 17|Gal.4:17.]] Pass., [[romans 3 27|Rom.3:27.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-κλίνω [in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;] intrans., to turn aside, turn away: metaphorically, from the right path, absol., [[romans 3 12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX); from evil, absol., [[1-peter 3 11|1Pe.3:11;]] before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), [[romans 16 17|Rom.16:17.]]† (AS)
to swim out of , with genitive, (Euripides) (ML)
ἐκ-κομίζω to carry out: as freq., a corpse for burial, [[luke 7 12|Luk.7:12.]]† (AS)

[[job 19 10|Job.19:10]] ἐλπίδα), [[2-corinthians 11 12|2Co.11:12.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-λαλέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Jdth.11:9 * ;] to speak out, divulge: [[acts 23 22|Act.23:22.]]† (AS)
ἐκ-λάμπω [in LXX for אוֹר hi., etc. ;] to shine forth: [[matthew 13 43|Mat.13:43.]]† (AS)
ἐκ-λανθάνω [in Sm.: [[psalms 13 2|Psa.13:2]] * ;] to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: [[hebrews 12 5|Heb.12:5.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-λέγω [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;] to pick out, choose. In NT always mid. (exc. [[luke 9 35|Luk.9:35]], ἐκλελεγμένος, WH, ἀγαπητός, R, mg.), to pick out for oneself, choose (cf. M, Pr., 157 f.): with accusative of thing(s), [[luke 10 42|Luk.10:42 14:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5 15:22, 25]]; of Christ (see supr.), [[luke 9 35|Luk.9:35;]] of Christ's choice of disciples, [[luke 6 13|Luk.6:13]], [[john 6 70|Jhn.6:70 13:18 15:16, 19]] [[acts 1 2|Act.1:2]]; of the Divine choice: of persons, [[mark 13 20|Mrk.13:20]], [[acts 1 24|Act.1:24 13:17 15:7]], [[ephesians 1 4|Eph.1:4]], [[james 2 5|Jas.2:5]]; of things, [[1-corinthians 1 27|1Co.1:27-28]] (Cremer, 402, 773).† (AS)

ἐκ-λείπω [in LXX for כָּלָה, כָּרַת ni., תָּמַם, etc., 47 different words in all ;] 1. trans., to leave out, pass over. 2. Intrans., to leave off, cease, fail: μαμωνᾶς, [[luke 16 9|Luk.16:9;]] πίστις, [[luke 22 32|Luk.22:32;]] ἔτη, [[hebrews 1 12|Heb.1:12]] (LXX); of the sun in an eclipse, [[luke 23 45|Luk.23:45.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν (ἐκλέγω), [in LXX for בָּחַר (so prob. in [[isaiah 28 16|Isa.28:16]], [[proverbs 17 3|Pro.17:3]], for MT בָּחַן), בָּרִיא, etc. ;] 1. choice, select (cl., rarely; Thuc., Plat., al.), hence, eminent: [[romans 16 13|Rom.16:13]] (cf. [[ezekiel 27 24|Eze.27:24]]). 2. As in Inscr. (MM, Exp., xii), chosen; esp. as in LXX, of Israel, elect, chosen of God ([[isaiah 65 9|Isa.65:9]], [[psalms 105 43|Psa.105:43]], al.); so in NT; (a) of Christ: [[luke 23 35|Luk.23:35]] (cf. [[isaiah 42 1|Isa.42:1]]); figuratively, λίθος, [[1-peter 2 4|1Pe.2:4-6]] (LXX); (b) of holy angels: [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21;]] (with) of Christians: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22, 24]], [[mark 13 20|Mrk.13:20, 22 13:27]], [[2-timothy 2 10|2Ti.2:10]], [[1-peter 1 1|1Pe.1:1]]; τ. θεοῦ, [[luke 18 7|Luk.18:7]], [[romans 8 33|Rom.8:33]], [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]], [[titus 1 1|Tit.1:1]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[matthew 24 31|Mat.24:31;]] ἐ. κυρία, II Jn 1; ἀδελφή, II Jn 13; γένος, [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX); κλητοὶ καὶ ἐ. κ. πιστοί, [[revelation 17 14|Rev.17:14;]] opposite to κλητός (not so in Epp.; see Lft. on [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]]), [[matthew 20 16|Mat.20:16]] (T, WH, txt., R, omit) [[matthew 22 14|Mat.22:14]] (Cremer, 405, 775).† (AS)

ἐκλογή, ῆς ἡ (ἐκλέγω), [in Aq.: [[isaiah 22 7|Isa.22:7;]] Sm., Th.: [[isaiah 37 24|Isa.37:24]] * ;] a choice, selection; in NT, always of the Divine choice (EV, election): σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς, genitive qual., a chosen vessel; κατ ἐ., [[romans 9 11|Rom.9:11 11:5, 28]]; with genitive of person(s), [[1-thessalonians 1 4|1Th.1:4]], [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10]]; by meton., ἡ ἐ. = οἱ ἐκλεκτοί, [[romans 11 7|Rom.11:7.]]† (AS)

ἐκ-λύω [in LXX for רָפָה, etc. ;] 1. to loose, release. 2. to unloose, as a bow-string, to relax, enfeeble; pass., to be faint, grow weary: [[matthew 15 32|Mat.15:32]], [[mark 8 3|Mrk.8:3]]; of mental weariness, [[galatians 6 9|Gal.6:9]], [[hebrews 12 3|Heb.12:3]], 5" (LXX) .† (AS)
ἐκ-μάσσω [in LXX: Sir.12:11, Ep. [[jeremiah 13 1|Jer.13:1-27 24:1-10]] * ;] to wipe off: with accusative, [[luke 7 38|Luk.7:38, 44]], [[john 11 2|Jhn.11:2 12:3 13:5]].† (AS)
ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω [in LXX: [[psalms 2 4|Psa.2:4 22:7 35:16]] (לָעַג), I [[esther 1 51|Est.1:51]] A* ;] to hold up the nose in derision at, scoff at: with accusative, [[luke 16 14|Luk.16:14 23:35]].† (AS)

ἐκ-νεύω [in LXX: [[judges 4 18|Jdg.4:18]] (סוּר) [[judges 18 26|Jdg.18:26]], [[2-kings 2 24|4Ki.2:24 23:16]] (פָּנָה), [[micah 6 14|Mic.6:14]] (סוּג hi.), 3Ma.3:22 * ;] 1. to bend the head aside (Xen.). 2. (a) to shun, avoid (Diod.); (b) to withdraw: [[john 5 13|Jhn.5:13]]† (AS)

ἐκ-νήφω [in LXX: [[genesis 9 24|Gen.9:24]], [[habakkuk 2 7|Hab.2:7]] (יָקַץ), [[joel 1 5|Jol.1:5]], [[habakkuk 2 19|Hab.2:19]] (יָקַץ hi.), [[1-samuel 25 37|1Ki.25:37]] (יָצָא), Sir.31:2 * ;] to become sober after drunkenness: metaphorically, of sobriety of mind, [[1-corinthians 15 34|1Co.15:34.]]† (AS)
ἐκούσιος, -ον (έκών), [in LXX chiefly for נְדָבָה, as [[numbers 15 3|Num.15:3]] (κατ᾽ ἑ) ;] usually of actions, voluntary: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.† (AS)
ἑκουσίως adv., [in LXX: [[psalms 54 6|Psa.54:6]] (נְדָבָה) 2Ma.14:3, al. ;] voluntarily, willingly: [[hebrews 10 26|Heb.10:26]], [[1-peter 5 2|1Pe.5:2]].† (AS)
ἔκ-παλαι adv. (of a class of compound adverbs common in late Gk.; see Mayor on 2 Pe, l.with), for a long time, from of old: [[2-peter 2 3|2Pe.2:3 3:5]].† (AS)

ἐκ-πειράζω [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 6 16|Deu.6:16 8:2, 16]] [[psalms 78 18|Psa.78:18]] (נָסָה pi.) * ;] = cl. ἐκπειράομαι, to put to the proof or test, make trial of, tempt: with accusative, of God, [[matthew 4 7|Mat.4:7]] (LXX), [[luke 4 12|Luk.4:12]] (ib.), [[1-corinthians 10 9|1Co.10:9;]] of Christ, [[luke 10 25|Luk.10:25]] (Cremer, 497).† (AS)
ἐκ-πέμπω [in LXX for שָׁלַח ;] to send forth: [[acts 13 4|Act.13:4 17:10]].† (AS)
